map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-21 03:00): early in person 16,867 (state 16,727). Clermont (as of 2026-10-21 11:24): mail returned 6,865 (state 6,838); early in person 7,874 (state 7,586). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-20 17:23): early in person 18,250 (state 18,191). Franklin (as of 2026-10-21 00:14): early in person 37,527 (state 37,193); ballots sent 78,934 (state 78,241). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-20 19:44): early in person 27,943 (state 27,702). Hancock: mail returned 1,531 (state 1,498). Morrow (as of 2026-10-20 16:21): mail returned 745 (state 743). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-21 07:36): mail returned 6,679 (state 6,677).
